title: Unifying Graph Neural Networks Through a Common Layer Equation
abstract: arXiv:2608.16097v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph neural networks are commonly described through family-specific equations whose notation obscures shared computations and structural differences. We introduce a common layer equation that represents covered architectures through seven components: an update domain, channel set, propagation bank, per-channel message maps, channel-fusion operator, ego/residual map, and update map. The central factorization separates where information moves, encoded by the propagation bank, from what moves, encoded by the message maps. Function-valued fillings extend the same equation across local message passing, attention, spectral filtering, global communication, relation-specific channels, higher-order domains, and geometric messages.   We make this unification explicit and checkable through worked reductions of canonical layers and component assignments spanning seven nonexclusive architectural families. translated_title: 通过统一层方程统一图神经网络
translated_abstract: 图神经网络通常通过特定于家族的方程来描述，这些方程的符号表示掩盖了共享计算和结构差异。我们引入了一个统一层方程，通过七个组件来表示所涵盖的架构：更新域、通道集、传播库、每通道消息映射、通道融合算子、自我/残差映射和更新映射。中心分解将信息移动的位置（由传播库编码）与移动的内容（由消息映射编码）分离。函数值填充将同一方程扩展到局部消息传递、注意力机制、谱滤波、全局通信、关系特定通道、高阶域和几何消息。我们通过典型层的详细归约和跨越七个非排他性架构家族的组件分配，使这种统一性变得明确且可验证。一个固定的槽位规则将操作分配到各个槽位。
tldr: 本文提出一个统一层方程，通过七个组件分解图神经网络的计算，将信息传播位置与内容分离，涵盖多种架构家族。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified layer equation that decomposes graph neural network computations into seven components, separating where information moves from what moves, covering diverse architecture families.
